page: Google Cloud Platform h4d-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the h4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1488.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. The instance includes NVMe SSD local storage and does not contain any GPU accelerators.

This server type offers high resource density, combining a large allocation of dedicated vCPUs with substantial memory capacity. The qualitative cost profile reflects its position as a high-capacity, memory-intensive resource. The absence of hardware GPU accelerators limits its use in deep learning training, but the high core count and memory allocation provide significant compute density for non-GPU workloads.

The h4d-highmem-192-lssd is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks. The combination of 192 dedicated vCPUs and nearly 1.5 TB of RAM makes it suitable for high-throughput in-memory databases, large-scale virtualization, and complex ETL pipelines.
